reference_sql:
SELECT category_name, COUNT(*) AS n_lines
FROM sales
WHERE units >= 2
GROUP BY category_name
HAVING COUNT(*) > 9000
alternatives: SELECT category_name, COUNT(*) AS n_lines FROM sales WHERE units > 1 GROUP BY category_name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 9001
SELECT category_name, COUNT(order_line_id) AS n_lines FROM sales WHERE NOT units < 2 GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(order_line_id) > 9000
